archetypes.name: step5-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 status envelopes and handoff branches are high-risk orchestration contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python review-and-fix Step 5 driver for parity with the retired shell contracts. Focus on final envelope emission, per-round KV suppression, MAV apply, main-agent handoff ledgers, and failure return codes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: migration-surface
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes many shell entrypoints and retargets docs, Make targets, and script callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit call-site cutover and retired-script references. Verify the deleted shell surfaces have no active references outside the migration manifest and that prompt-facing fences use the Python CLI through larch-run where needed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: coder-dispatch
archetypes.rationale: Accepted findings are untrusted reviewer data and external coder dispatch is a trust boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the accepted-finding coder prompt, submodule scrub handling, Codex/Cursor launch path, and skipped/security OOS handling. Check for raw Codex exec, unsafe reviewer prose treatment, or weakened submodule protections. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
